Thank you all for surfacing these considerations — this is exactly why I wanted to have this conversation before finalizing anything. Let me address each one in turn.

First, Marcus, thank you for disclosing that Rina is Jonah's close personal friend and has been coaching him. That's a clear conflict of interest, and I will not appoint Rina to the panel. That leaves Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq as our three panelists.

Second, Priya, I appreciate you flagging Elliot's four firsthand observations of Mara coaching team members through difficult disagreements. Since Elliot is now on the panel, we need to ensure those observations are formally documented in the leadership-evidence record before the panel conducts its evaluations, so they're part of the structured assessment rather than informal recollections. Can you commit to entering those four observations into the formal record before the evaluation?

Third, Sofia, thank you for confirming the standardized question set and individual written score sheet requirements. I'll make sure those are explicitly stated in the selection packet before the panel proceeds.

Fourth, Tariq, thank you for raising Mara's accessibility need on her behalf. Under our accessibility practice, this is now formally raised through you as employee representative, so I will implement it: Mara will receive the interview questions at least 48 hours in advance and may submit written responses instead of answering verbally. We'll need to make sure the written format still gives her equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the leadership criteria, and I'd like your input on how to ensure that equivalence.

Before I finalize, I want to do my routine round-robin check. I've now heard from Marcus, Priya, Sofia, and Tariq. Does anyone have any additional process or relationship considerations I should record in the selection log before I settle on the final decisions?
